// 02 PROJECTS
Industrial Metal Surface Defect Classification
100% controlled test*
COMPUTER VISION

An end-to-end deep-learning pipeline for 5-class industrial metal-surface defect classification across 15,000 images: crack, hole, normal, rust and scratch.

  • Benchmarked a custom CNN, EfficientNet-B0 and AlexNet across six training configurations.
  • 70/15/15 train-validation-test split with reproducible evaluation.
  • Selected EfficientNet-B0 using validation metrics.
  • Explicitly evaluated generalization limits and real-world validation needs.

Network Intrusion Classification with PySpark
2.52M records
BIG DATA

A distributed multiclass classification project on the CICIDS2017 dataset — roughly 2.52 million network records across seven traffic classes.

  • Decision Tree baseline with reproducible preprocessing.
  • Weighted Random Forest tuned using 3-fold cross-validation.
  • StandardScaler → PCA → K-Means branch with silhouette analysis.
  • Combined supervised, unsupervised and ensemble analysis.
